family: Published backtests, forward-test results, and documented failure modes for ES/NQ/MES/MNQ day-trading systems (incl. realistic MES/MNQ costs at Lucid and the 2025-2026 ES/NQ volatility regime)

specs.name: Mesfin ORB long, 25-min opening range, 75-min time exit (optional SMA200 trend filter, VVG skip, one-loss rule)
specs.evidence: EQ 4. Mesfin arXiv 2605.04004 walk-forward OOS N=447, net +2.82 MNQ pts/trade (gross +4.82) at 2.0-pt friction, by year +2.43/+7.04/+15.05, T 0.88 (failed author's gate on T but positive every OOS year). Shorts negative (-3.45/-2.16, T -3.16) and not specified. ORB family report found SMA200 + one-loss variant survives OOS.
specs.pseudocode:
PARAMS: or_start=09:30, or_minutes=25, hold_min=75, trend_filter none|sma200, stop_mode or_low|atr(stop_atr=0.5), last_entry=11:30, max_trades=1, skip_vvg=False.
PRE: B5=resample(df1,5,rth_only=True); OR=opening_range(df1,09:30,25)->or_high,or_low,i_end; atr=ATR14d (daily RTH ATR shifted 1 day); sma200=sma(daily RTH close,200).shift(1); vvg=spec7.vvg_big_day.
PER SESSION d: skip if atr NaN; if trend_filter==sma200 skip unless prev_close[d] > sma200[d]; if skip_vvg and vvg[d] skip day.
For 5-min bars k of day d with tod[k] >= 09:55 and tod[k]+5 <= 11:30: if B5.close[k] > or_high[d] (first 5-min CLOSE above OR high): i=B5.i_next[k] (skip if -1); c=close[k]; stop = or_low[d] (or_low) or c-0.5*atr (atr); stop=min(stop, c-min_stop_pts) [MNQ 6/MES 4]; place(i,+1,stop_px=stop,max_hold=hold_min) i.e. market at next 1-min open, exit after hold_min 1-min bars; break (one entry/day).
No profit target (pure time exit as published). Mandatory delay=1 sensitivity run (order at i_next[k+1]).
SESSION: set_session(09:55,11:30,15:55); max_trades_day=max_trades.
specs.params_grid: hold_min {60,75,120}; trend_filter {none,sma200}; stop_mode {or_low, atr0.5}; skip_vvg {False,True} = 24 combos. Fixed: OR 25 min, last_entry 11:30, max_trades 1 (one extra run max_trades=2 with dls_mult 1.0 = one loss ends day).
specs.session_rules: RTH only. Entries 09:55-11:30 ET, market at next 1-min open after the signal 5-min bar; forced flat 15:55. Time exit after 60-120 min. No overnight.
specs.risk_rules: Hard stop at OR low (or 0.5xATR14d), floored at 5x RT cost. daily_loss_stop per micro MNQ $40 / MES $35 (x1.0); daily_profit_stop MNQ $60 / MES $50 (x2.0). max_trades_day 1. Wide-stop system: expect Lucid scan to settle at 3-6 micros. Pass bar: positive net each of 2023-2026, >=30 trades/yr, gross/trade >= 4 MNQ pts, stress slip_ticks=2.

specs.name: Mesfin gap-continuation short via first-30-minute velocity z-score (OLS slope approximation of Kalman velocity)
specs.evidence: EQ 3. Mesfin OOS N=35 (~12/fold): net +14.52 pts (gross +16.53), T 1.46, by year +14.53/-11.87/+10.27; fails year stability and N per fold; author names it best candidate for more data. Our 2010-2026 1-min history triples N.
specs.data_gap: Kalman-filter velocity replaced by OLS slope of the 30 one-minute closes 09:30-09:59 standardised by its trailing 60-day distribution (flagged approximation, faithful in spirit).
specs.pseudocode:
PARAMS: z_thr=2.5, z_lookback=60 days, side short|both, exit time75|time180|close, stop_atr=0.5, tgt_atr None|1.0, require_gap=True, entry_time=10:00, max_trades=1.
PRE per session d: x = closes of the 1-min bars 09:30..09:59 (skip if <28 bars); slope[d]=OLS_slope(x)/O930[d]; z[d]=(slope[d]-mean(slope[d-60..d-1]))/std(slope[d-60..d-1]) (strictly past days); gap[d]=O930/prev_close-1; a=ATR14d[d].
SIGNAL at 10:00 (decision on close of 09:59 bar c; i = index of bar tod 10:00): short if z[d] <= -z_thr and (not require_gap or gap[d] < 0); long if side==both and z[d] >= +z_thr and (not require_gap or gap[d] > 0).
stop_px = c +/- max(stop_atr*a, min_stop_pts); tgt_px = c -/+ tgt_atr*a if tgt_atr else NaN; max_hold = 75 or 180 (1-min bars) for time exits, 0 for exit==close (flat 15:55). place(i, side, stop_px, tgt_px, max_hold).
SESSION: set_session(10:00,10:01,15:55); max_trades_day=1. Delay=1 sensitivity run.
specs.params_grid: z_thr {1.5,2.0,2.5}; side {short,both}; exit {time75,time180,close}; tgt_atr {None,1.0} = 36 combos. Fixed lookback 60, require_gap True (one run False), stop_atr 0.5.
specs.session_rules: RTH only; single entry at 10:00 ET market; exit by time (75/180 min) or forced flat 15:55.
specs.risk_rules: Stop 0.5xATR14d (~150 MNQ pts) floored at 5x RT cost; one trade/day so daily stops are moot; single-trade SD in paper 59 MNQ pts = +/-$1,180 at 10 micros which can breach the eval consistency cap: size via Lucid scan (expect 3-5 micros). Pass bar: positive net in >=3 of 4 years with >=25 trades/yr at z<=2.0; if only z=2.5 with N<30 is profitable, drop.

specs.name: Mesfin London Session Signal B: regime-transition long on 15-min bars 03:00-08:30 ET, 60-min hold (rule-based regime proxy; optional GMM)
specs.evidence: EQ 3. Walk-forward OOS N=247, net +4.09 MNQ pts/trade, SD 14.97, T 4.30, p 0.000025, win 61.5%, T 3.87-4.83 across parameter variations, unconditional long benchmark -0.47 pts; one-bar delay flips to T -2.78 (possible bar-boundary artefact); single author/instrument.
specs.data_gap: FLAGGED: paper's volume z-score feature replaced by range_z(50) on 15-min bars; 3-component GMM regimes replaced by a deterministic rule (impl 'rule', default) with a GMM option (impl 'gmm', sklearn, refit on years < test year).
specs.pseudocode:
PARAMS: bar=15, win 03:00-08:30, last_entry 07:30, hold_min=60, stop_pts=20*PT (MNQ 20, MES 5.6, MGC 2.4), z_window=100 bars, ret_z_thr=0.5, atr_z_r1=1.5, act_z_r1=2.0, clpos_min=0.6, dc_min=0.5, regime_impl rule|gmm.
PRE: B=resample(df1,15,rth_only=False) continuous 15-min bars over the 18:00-17:00 session. Features per bar k (bars<=k only): atr_ratio=ATR_15(5)/ATR_15(20); act=range_z(50) [VOLUME PROXY]; clpos=(close-low)/(high-low); ret=close/close[k-1]-1; dc=mean(sign(ret[k-3..k])). z_atr,z_act,z_ret = rolling z over z_window bars (min_periods full).
REGIME rule: R1 if z_atr>1.5 or z_act>2.0; elif z_ret>ret_z_thr and clpos>=0.6 and dc>=0.5 -> R2; elif z_atr<=0.5 and (ret<=0 or dc<=0) -> R0; else N.
REGIME gmm: per calendar year Y fit GaussianMixture(3,full,seed 0) on StandardScaled 5-feature vectors of London-window bars in years < Y; map highest mean z_atr -> R1, higher mean dc of the rest -> R2, remaining -> R0.
SIGNAL on bar k with 03:00 <= tod[k] and tod[k]+15 <= 07:30: if label[k]==R2 and label[k-1]==R0 and label[k-2]!=R1: i=B.i_next[k] (skip -1); place(i,+1,stop_px=B.close[k]-stop_pts,max_hold=hold_min) -- market at the exact next 1-min open, no confirmation bar.
SESSION: set_session(03:00,07:30,08:30); max_trades_day=2. Gold: 03:00-07:00 entries, flat 08:15.
DELAY TEST mandatory: rerun with i=B.i_next[k+1]; paper flips sign; report either way.
specs.params_grid: z_window {50,100}; ret_z_thr {0.5,1.0}; stop_pts {20,40} x PT; hold_min {45,60,90} = 24 combos (impl rule); plus one impl=gmm run at defaults.
specs.session_rules: Pre-market window 03:00-08:30 ET (Lucid-allowed), last entry 07:30 so a 60-min hold ends by 08:30; forced flat 08:30 before the 08:30 prints; never holds into RTH.
specs.risk_rules: Fixed 20 MNQ-pt stop ($40/micro, >= 5x RT); daily_loss_stop MNQ $40 (x1.0, one loss ends session); daily_profit_stop MNQ $60 (x1.0). ETH slippage: headline numbers from stress run slip_ticks=2. Pass bar: >=50 trades/yr, win >=55%, net >=3 MNQ pts base / >=2 stress, positive each of 2023-2026.

specs.name: Mesfin RTH Confluence mechanic stripped of volume/Markov gates: ATR-scaled limit pullback after an active up-bar, 65-min hold
specs.bar_size: 5-minute RTH bars on 1-minute data (ATR on 1-minute bars)
specs.evidence: EQ 3 for the published signal (OOS N=196, +11.82 pts, T 3.11, 2025 OOS +13.14; unconditional 09:30 long 13-bar hold -2.60) but the published signal is not reproducible without volume; 53+ parameter combinations searched by the author.
specs.data_gap: FLAGGED: 50-bar volume z-score gate replaced by range_z(50); GMM regime 1 ('Active Flow') replaced by a rule; Markov P(1->2)>0.15 gate dropped (needs GMM label history). Paper's fixed 10.34 ATR baseline (look-ahead) replaced by trailing 60-session median. Engine counts max_hold from fill, paper from signal bar (holds up to 30 min longer).
specs.pseudocode:
PARAMS: pull_pts=25*PT, stop_pts=80*PT, valid_min=30, hold_min=65, act_z_min=0.5, clpos_min=0.6, atr_lo=0.8, atr_hi=2.0, entry_start 09:35, last_signal 14:30, max_trades=2.
PRE: B5=resample(df1,5,rth_only=True); atr1 = Wilder ATR(20) on 1-min bars evaluated at B5.i_last[k]; base[d]=median of atr1 at 10:00 over the 60 RTH sessions before d; atr_ratio[k]=clip(atr1/base[d],0.5,2.0); act=range_z(50) on B5 (VOLUME PROXY); clpos; ret5.
SIGNAL on 5-min bar k (09:35 <= tod < 14:30): active_flow = ret5>0 and clpos>=clpos_min and atr_lo<=atr_ratio<=atr_hi and act>act_z_min. If active_flow: i=B5.i_next[k] (skip -1); px=close[k]-pull_pts*atr_ratio[k]; place(i,+1,entry_px=px,kind='limit',valid_bars=valid_min,stop_px=px-max(stop_pts*atr_ratio,min_stop_pts),max_hold=hold_min). Limit fills only on 1-tick trade-through; cancelled after valid_min 1-min bars; one pending order at a time.
SESSION: set_session(09:35,14:30,15:55); max_trades_day=max_trades.
specs.params_grid: pull_pts {15,25}xPT; stop_pts {40,80}xPT; hold_min {45,65}; act_z_min {0.0 (gate off), 0.5} = 16 combos; second pass max_trades {1,2} on best corner. clpos_min fixed 0.6.
specs.session_rules: RTH only; signals 09:35-14:30 ET; resting limit valid 30 min; time exit 45-65 min after fill; forced flat 15:55.
specs.risk_rules: Stop 40-80 x atr_ratio MNQ pts ($80-160/micro at ratio 1): 40-pt corner is the prop-sized one. daily_loss_stop MNQ $40 (x1.0); daily_profit_stop MNQ $60 (x2.0). Pass bar: positive 2025 and 2026 separately and 2023-24 combined, >=40 trades/yr, and act_z_min=0.5 must improve PF over 0.0 (independent-filter test) else spec collapses to a known-negative benchmark.

specs.name: NQ 'Strategy B': 5-minute bullish FVG nested inside a 15-minute bullish FVG, long only, 2R target, 09:30-12:00 entries, flat 15:45
specs.evidence: EQ 2. GitHub prashanthaitha24/nq-strategy-b-bot, 1 MNQ Jan 2023-May 2026: 432 trades, win 53.5%, PF ~2.3, net +$17,187, max DD $786, 4/4 years, 35/41 months; 2025: 117 tr, 57.3%, PF 2.47, +$6,623, DD $786. Fees included, slippage unstated, no walk-forward; rising win rate 46->68% is a tuning red flag. Best-shaped candidate in the family for Lucid.
specs.data_gap: None (OHLC only; FVG = 3-bar gap pattern). Deviations flagged: min_R/max_R guards and min_gap thresholds added for cost floor.
specs.pseudocode:
PARAMS: rr=2.0, buffer_pts=5*PT, stop_off_pts=2*PT, min_gap5=2*PT, min_gap15=5*PT, max_age5=36 (5-min bars), max_age15=24, entry 09:30-12:00, flat 15:45, max_trades=2, side long|both, same_session_only=False, min_R=8*PT, max_R=60*PT.
PRE: B5=resample(df1,5,rth_only=True); B15=resample(df1,15,rth_only=True) (continuous RTH chart). Bullish FVG at bar j of series X: X.low[j] > X.high[j-2]+min_gap -> zone{bottom=X.high[j-2], top=X.low[j], born_i=X.i_last[j]}. Bearish (side both): X.high[j] < X.low[j-2]-min_gap -> zone{bottom=X.high[j], top=X.low[j-2]}. Active from bar j+1 until first later bar with low <= bottom (fully filled) or age > max_age; if same_session_only zones die at session end. F5 = 5-min bullish zones; F15 = 15-min bullish zones.
SIGNAL on 5-min bar k with 09:30 <= tod[k] and tod[k]+5 <= 12:00: cands = {f in F5 active at k, f.born_i < B5.i_first[k], exists F in F15 active with F.born_i < B5.i_first[k] and f.bottom >= F.bottom and f.top <= F.top+buffer_pts, B5.low[k] <= f.top and B5.low[k] > f.bottom, B5.close[k] > f.top}. If cands: f = highest top; i=B5.i_next[k] (skip -1); c=close[k]; stop=f.bottom-stop_off_pts; R=c-stop; skip if R<min_R or R>max_R; place(i,+1,stop_px=stop,tgt_px=c+rr*R) market at next open. side both: mirror with bearish zones (expect to reject; README shorts 42.5% win).
SESSION: set_session(09:30,12:00,15:45); max_trades_day=max_trades.
specs.params_grid: rr {1.5,2.0,3.0}; buffer_pts {5,10}xPT; age axis {24 same-session, 36 continuous, 72 continuous} (max_age15 = 2/3 of max_age5); max_trades {1,2} = 36 combos. One extra run side=both at defaults.
specs.session_rules: RTH only; entries 09:30-12:00 ET market at next 1-min open after the signal 5-min bar; hard exit 15:45 as published; never overnight.
specs.risk_rules: Stop = 5-min FVG bottom - 2 pts; R typically 10-30 MNQ pts ($20-60/micro), min_R 8 pts enforces >=5x RT cost. daily_loss_stop MNQ $40 / MES $35 (x1.0, effectively one-loss rule at 10 micros); daily_profit_stop MNQ $60 / MES $50 (x1.0). Prop-friendly at 10-20 micros. Pass bar: positive each of 2023-2026, PF>=1.3 with >=100 trades/yr, win>=50%, plateau across rr 1.5-3 and buffer 5-10; apply 1.5-2.5x haircut before sizing.

specs.name: Zarattini noise-area breakout, VIX/ATR-gated, with fixed ATR target or 90-min time exit instead of EOD band-trailing
specs.evidence: EQ 4 for the in-sample effect and EQ 4 for its decay: two independent replications give OOS Sharpe 0.39 (May 2024-Mar 2026), ES 2025 Sharpe -0.27, 2026 YTD -1.91; brusco VIX-regime tables show the edge lived in VIX>20. Report recommends salvage as vol-gated breakout definition with fixed/timed exits (Davey exit ranking).
specs.data_gap: None (band variant; VWAP stop not used). Sibling specs cover the paper's own exits; this id is the timed/gated variant only.
specs.pseudocode:
PARAMS: lookback=14 days, vm=1.0, gate none|vix|atr, vix_min=20, atrpct_min (NQ 0.9, ES 0.6 % of close), first_entry 10:00, last_entry 14:30, exit target|time, tgt_atr=0.5, hold_min=90, hard_stop_atr=0.5, long_only=False, max_trades=2.
PRE per session d (RTH 1-min bars): move[d,t]=|close(tod t)/O930[d]-1|; M=pivot(day_id x tod); sigma[d,t]=M.rolling(14,min_periods=14).mean().shift(1) (days<d); UB[d,t]=max(O930,prev_close)*(1+vm*sigma); LB[d,t]=min(O930,prev_close)*(1-vm*sigma); allowed[d] = sigma ok and ATR14d ok and (gate none, or vix: VIX_lag[d]>=vix_min, or atr: 100*ATR14d/prev_close >= atrpct_min).
SIGNAL on 1-min bar t (10:00 <= tod < 14:30), once per direction per day: if close[t] > UB[d,t] and close[t-1] <= UB[d,t-1]: i=t+1; c=close[t]; place(i,+1,stop_px=c-hard_stop_atr*ATR14d, tgt_px=c+tgt_atr*ATR14d if exit==target else NaN, max_hold=hold_min if exit==time else 0). If not long_only: mirror short on first downward cross of LB.
SESSION: set_session(10:00,14:30,15:55); max_trades_day=max_trades.
specs.params_grid: gate {none, vix20, atr}; exit {target0.5ATR, target1.0ATR, time90}; hard_stop_atr {0.35,0.5}; long_only {False,True} = 36 combos. Fixed lookback 14, vm 1.0, max_trades 2.
specs.session_rules: RTH only; entries 10:00-14:30 ET market at next 1-min open on first band cross of the day per direction; exit by target, 90-min time, or forced flat 15:55.
specs.risk_rules: Stop 0.35-0.5xATR14d (~100-150 MNQ pts, $200-300/micro) -> 3-6 micros. daily_loss_stop MNQ $40 (x1.0); daily_profit_stop MNQ $60 (x2.0). gate=none corner must reproduce the published 2025-26 decay (implementation check). Pass bar: gated corner >=30 trades/yr with PF>=1.3 in 2025Q1-Q2 and 2026Q1 while flat in 2025Q3.

specs.name: Reusable no-trade / mode gates: VVG big-day skip (|gap| and |first-30| top terciles), range-regime persistence, volatility floor
specs.instruments: All (MES, MNQ, MGC); applied to other specs
specs.bar_size: Daily plus first 30 minutes (decision 10:00 for VVG, pre-open for the others)
specs.evidence: EQ 3. VVG (arXiv 2605.11423): flagged days reverse from intraday peak 77.6% of the time, mean giveback 11.73 pts, no directional rule survives (best T 1.46). Range persistence 58.9% / regime lens 65.2% walk-forward (Matswm86). Vol floor: Hart method (EQ 2); local 2025Q3 ES RV 8.9% dead zone computed from workspace data.
specs.data_gap: VVG's first-bar-volume condition dropped (OHLC-only version uses |gap| and |first-30| terciles only, ~11% of days vs 4.4%). Matswm86's 63.9%/65.2% model is undisclosed; only the persistence baseline is coded.
specs.pseudocode:
PRE per session d: gap[d]=O930/prev_close-1; r30[d]=close(09:59)/prev_close-1; rng[d-1]=pd_high-pd_low; ATR14d; VIX_lag.
GATE 1 vvg_big_day[d] (decision 10:00): qg=expanding_q(|gap|,2/3,min_n=120); qr=expanding_q(|r30|,2/3,min_n=120) over days<d; vvg_big_day = |gap[d]|>=qg and |r30[d]|>=qr. Usage: allow_entry[i] &= not (vvg_big_day[d] and tod[i]>=10:00) for breakout specs.
GATE 2 range_regime[d] (pre-open): med=median(rng[d-20..d-1]); ratio=rng[d-1]/med; WIDE if ratio>1.1, NARROW if <0.9, else NOCALL. Breakout specs trade WIDE/NOCALL; mean-reversion specs NARROW/NOCALL.
GATE 3 vol_floor[d] (pre-open): atrpct=100*ATR14d/prev_close; vol_floor = atrpct >= thr (MES 0.6, MNQ 0.9, MGC 0.8) or VIX_lag>=14. Usage: allow_entry &= vol_floor for breakout/momentum specs.
VALIDATION (Swanson): for each gate g and baseline s in {orb_long_75min, fvg_nested_long, noise_band_timed}: run s with/without g on 2023-01..2026-09; keep g for s only if PF and net/maxDD both improve and trades stay >=70% of ungated; never stack more than two gates.
specs.params_grid: vvg_q {0.6,0.667}; regime band {+/-10%,+/-20%}; vol thr {0.8x,1.0x of table}; evaluated only through the validation loop (no standalone P&L).
specs.session_rules: VVG gate applies to entries with tod >= 10:00 ET only (needs first 30 min); range and vol gates are pre-open daily flags using days < d.
specs.risk_rules: Not a trading system. A gate that removes >30% of trades without improving net/DD is rejected. Expect vol_floor to switch systems off for most of 2025Q3.

specs.name: Gao-Han-Li-Zhou / Baltussen last-30-minute intraday momentum, VIX-gated (negative control / harness calibration)
specs.evidence: EQ 5 for the 1993-2020 papers; EQ 1-2 for 2023-2026: local check first-30->last-30 same-sign 44.8-50.2%, to-15:30->last-30 correlation -0.08..+0.06 since 2024, mean last-30 move 17 bps. Expected to fail; listed as the calibration case (an edge here at base costs means the cost model or look-ahead guards are broken).
specs.data_gap: Dealer gamma not available; VIX gate stands in for negative-gamma/high-vol days.
specs.pseudocode:
PARAMS: signal to1530|first30, vix_min None|20|25, min_abs_ret=0.003, stop_atr=0.25, entry 15:30, flat 15:55.
PRE per session d: r = close(15:29)/prev_close-1 (to1530) or close(09:59)/prev_close-1 (first30); allowed = (vix_min None or VIX_lag[d]>=vix_min) and |r|>=min_abs_ret.
SIGNAL at 15:30 (i = index of bar tod 15:30; c=close(15:29)): if allowed: place(i, sign(r), stop_px = c - sign(r)*max(stop_atr*ATR14d[d], min_stop_pts)); no target; forced flat 15:55.
SESSION: set_session(15:30,15:31,15:55); max_trades_day=1.
specs.session_rules: One market entry at 15:30 ET, flat 15:55 (25-min hold). RTH only.
specs.risk_rules: Stop 0.25xATR14d (~75 MNQ pts) floored at 5x RT cost; one trade/day so daily stops are moot. Expect PF ~1.0 ungated; VIX>=25 gate selects ~25 days/yr.

specs.name: ICT previous-day-high (PDH/PDL) break-and-retest with optional Silver Bullet hour windows
specs.evidence: EQ 1. asiatrada README: PDH break-retest 61% win, PF 1.89 on a 60-day sweep; 14+ months 141 trades 63%+ win PF 1.89; no costs, no dates, no OOS. Codeable and overlaps the session-structure break-and-retest logic that survived (London reclaim).
specs.data_gap: None. README gives names only; standard interpretation used.
specs.pseudocode:
PARAMS: level pdh (long) / pdl (short mirror), side long|both, buf_atr=0.05, tol_atr=0.15, fail_atr=0.25, max_wait=12 (5-min bars), rr=2.0, window all (09:35-14:30) | sb (10:00-11:00 and 14:00-15:00), max_trades=2, stop_mode retest_low|level.
PRE: B5=resample(df1,5,rth_only=True); L[d]=pd_high[d] (long) / pd_low[d] (short); a=ATR14d[d].
STATE MACHINE per session (long; short mirrors): IDLE: on bar k (tod>=09:35) with close[k] > L+buf_atr*a and close[k-1] <= L+buf_atr*a -> BROKEN, t_break=k. BROKEN: on bar k with k-t_break <= max_wait: if close[k] < L-fail_atr*a -> IDLE (false break, may re-arm once); elif low[k] <= L+tol_atr*a and low[k] >= L-fail_atr*a and close[k] > L (retest holds): if window==sb and tod[k]+5 not in [10:00,11:00) U [14:00,15:00): continue; i=B5.i_next[k] (skip -1); c=close[k]; stop = low[k]-buf_atr*a (retest_low) or L-fail_atr*a (level); R=c-stop; if R<min_stop_pts: stop=c-min_stop_pts, R=min_stop_pts; place(i,+1,stop_px=stop,tgt_px=c+rr*R) -> DONE (re-arm if max_trades allows); elif k-t_break > max_wait -> IDLE.
SESSION: set_session(09:35,14:30,15:55); max_trades_day=max_trades.

specs.name: marcwong 3-touch support/resistance breakout (swing-pivot clusters) with stop floored at 0.25 ATR
specs.evidence: EQ 1. GitHub marcwong515-art/futures-backtester: honest execution model (1 tick/side + $1.50/side, gap-through stop fills) but results tables unpopulated, live log pending. Repo stop (1/4 of breakout-bar wick) is below the friction floor on micros (kjw616 lesson) and is replaced.
specs.data_gap: None. Deviation flagged: stop = max(wick/4, 0.25xATR14d, min_stop_pts) instead of wick/4.
specs.pseudocode:
PARAMS: pivot_n=3, lookback_bars=234 (~3 RTH days of 5-min bars), tol_atr=0.10, min_touches=3, buf_atr=0.05, stop_floor_atr=0.25, exit session|rr2, side both, max_trades=2, entry 09:45-14:30.
PRE: B5=resample(df1,5,rth_only=True); a=ATR14d[d]. swing_high[j] confirmed at bar j+pivot_n when high[j]==max(high[j-pivot_n..j+pivot_n]); swing_low likewise. At bar k: pivots = confirmed swings within the last lookback_bars bars (confirmation index <= k); single-linkage cluster pivots within tol_atr*a; level=mean, touches=cluster size; resistance = clusters with touches>=min_touches and price>close[k]; support likewise below.
SIGNAL on bar k (09:45 <= tod < 14:30): nearest resistance Rv: if close[k] > Rv+buf_atr*a and close[k-1] <= Rv+buf_atr*a: i=B5.i_next[k]; wick=close[k]-low[k]; stop=close[k]-max(wick/4, stop_floor_atr*a, min_stop_pts); place(i,+1,stop_px=stop,tgt_px=close[k]+2*(close[k]-stop) if exit==rr2 else NaN) (session exit: flat 15:55). Mirror for support (short) if side both.

specs.name: Kevin Davey exit study replicated day-trade-only: neutral 60-min momentum entry, five exit types ranked (SAR, dollar target, breakeven, trailing, parabolic)
specs.evidence: EQ 3. Davey 567,000 backtests on 40 futures incl. ES/NQ/GC, 2010-2020, real-money costs: stop-and-reverse > dollar target > breakeven > trailing > parabolic; metals and stock indices profitable on average. Vendor-published without underlying numbers. Output is an exit ranking that feeds the exit grids of specs 1, 6, 9, 10.
specs.data_gap: None. Engine gaps flagged: no parabolic trail (approximated by ATR trail + 3-hour time cap); breakeven approximated with trail_act_pts/trail_pts (ratchets to ~entry at +0.5 ATR).
specs.pseudocode:
PARAMS: len=15 (60-min bars), atr_n=14, exit_mode in {sar,dollar,breakeven,trail,parabolic}, tgt_usd=60 per micro (MNQ 30 pts / MES 12 / MGC 6), stop_atr=1.0, trail_atr=1.0, be_act_atr=0.5, max_trades=3.
PRE: B60=resample(df1,60,rth_only=True) (bars 09:30-10:00 truncated, then 10:00-11:00 ... 15:00-16:00, continuous across days); hh[k]=max(close[k-len..k-1]); ll[k]=min(close[k-len..k-1]); a60=ATR_60(atr_n).
ENTRY on bar k with tod[k]+60 <= 14:00: long if close[k] > hh[k]; short if close[k] < ll[k]; i=B60.i_next[k]; c=close[k]; s=max(stop_atr*a60[k], min_stop_pts).
EXIT by mode: sar: place(i,side,stop_px=c-/+2*s); on opposite signal at bar m: exit_at(B60.i_next[m]) and place(B60.i_next[m]+1,-side,...) (flip pattern); flat 15:55. dollar: place(i,side,stop_px=c-/+s,tgt_pts=tgt_usd/point_value). breakeven: place(i,side,stop_px=c-/+s,trail_pts=be_act_atr*a60,trail_act_pts=be_act_atr*a60). trail: place(i,side,stop_px=c-/+s,trail_pts=trail_atr*a60,trail_act_pts=0). parabolic: trail + max_hold=180.
